UnitStatement: Test module covers the TP-MAC-01 product-preview service slice.

Preview model fixture validates as passed, declares document_kind openpipestress.product_preview.model, enforces invented_or_cleared_data_only public-examples policy, and contains no 'code compliant' claim.
Model tree preserves stable entity ids (node:N-100, pipe:P-120, support:S-130, component:C-140) and every entity carries properties.
Design-knowledge records all carry provenance 'invented_example' and diagnostics expose RULE_CHECK_NOT_PERFORMED and SUPPORT_STIFFNESS_UNRESOLVED codes.
Mechanics result keeps status boundaries separate: mechanics MECHANICS_SOLVED, rule_check RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE, professional_acceptance NOT_PROVIDED, and accepted model state is not mutated.
Mechanics result entries carry metadata for coordinate_system, location, component, basis, and basis_ref binding results to load cases or combinations.
Analysis-run preview binds mechanics results to an immutable read-only run record (deliverable DEL-14-02) and includes HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED status.
Analysis-run preview asserts the software makes no compliance claim (software_makes_compliance_claim is False).
Report-packet preview materializes a read-only audit-context packet referencing the source analysis run with no rendered report, export payload, or acceptance record.
Report packet asserts no compliance claim and no private or protected payload embedded.
Preview validation blocks empty ids and missing provenance, emitting PREVIEW_ID_MISSING and PREVIEW_PROVENANCE_MISSING.
Preview validation blocks invalid explicit combinations (unsupported basis, invalid factor, unknown load case, empty terms).
Agent proposal preview is review-only and non-mutating: application_status not_applied, requires user acceptance, mutates no accepted model state, no 'certified' claim.
Shared JSON Schema validation helpers module for PKG-02 contract tests.
INSTALL_MESSAGE states jsonschema>=4,<5 is required for full PKG-02 JSON Schema validation.
JsonSchemaDependencyMissing is raised when optional JSON Schema validation tooling is unavailable.
validate_schema_document validates a schema document against Draft 2020-12.
schema_for_definition builds a small root schema validating one definition extracted from a larger schema's $defs.
validate_instance validates an instance against a schema and raises an assertion with compact error paths.
Policy checks for the local-first storage contract (DEL-12-01 / PKG-12).

Local-first private storage classes include private project models, private rule packs, private material/component libraries, owner standards, company design bases, credentials, secrets, diagnostics, reports, generated outputs, and user-controlled data.
Symbolic path classes are planning names (e.g. PUBLIC_REPOSITORY_CONTENT, USER_PRIVATE_LIBRARY_ROOT, USER_SECRET_REFERENCE), not filesystem paths.

Persistence baseline preserves versioned, schema-governed, unit-aware, provenance-preserving records with deterministic round-trip serialization and canonical JSON/JCS hashes over local SQLite storage with rebuildable FTS5/BM25 sidecars.
No-bypass surfaces (plugins, adapters, import/export, reports, telemetry, CLI runners, diagnostics, tests, application services) cannot bypass storage controls.
Storage-record classification is deterministic and metadata-only, yielding PRIVATE_METADATA_LOCAL_FIRST with contains_payload, secret_material_present, and direct_sql_access all False.
Public repository blocks private storage payloads requiring metadata-only, without leaking project/rule/material/component/report/diagnostic/cache/secret payload values.
Local private storage of private metadata requires explicit user intent: blocked without intent (LOCAL_PRIVATE_INTENT_REQUIRED), allowed with intent (PRIVATE_LOCAL_METADATA_ALLOWED).
Public-repository locality blocks private storage even with local-private intent (PUBLIC_REPOSITORY_PRIVATE_STORAGE_BLOCKED).
Cloud/network references, direct SQL access, secret material, and concrete paths are sanitized to safe metadata without leaking sensitive details.
Policy text is traceable to deliverable scope (DEL-12-01, PKG-12, SOW-029, OBJ-010).
Policy states OpenPipeStress is local-first by default and lists local-first private classes.
Public repository is not a default durable storage location and must not be used as default durable storage.
Symbolic path classes are defined in policy text without any real filesystem path markers.
Unresolved storage choices remain explicit warning, finding, or unsupported (TBD) rather than silently resolved.
Policy makes no cloud, encryption, secret-storage, or runtime-storage commitment and remains free to use and usable offline.
No runtime storage code or schema was added (core/storage, apps/storage, schemas/storage.schema.yaml absent).
Checks for DEL-12-02 redaction/export controls using invented fixtures.
Redaction schema requires defs including ControlProfile, ExportContext, FieldPolicy, RedactionDecision, RedactionFinding, and PrivacyClassification.
Redaction policy actions are warning_only, redact_value, redact_field, omit_field, and block_export.
Redaction schema is strict (additionalProperties False) and traceable to DEL-12-02, PKG-12, SOW-040, OBJ-010.

Redaction schema vocabularies cover required privacy classes, actions, export contexts, and reason codes; ControlProfile asserts local_first True, cloud_transmission_allowed False, professional_claims_allowed False.
Public-report export redacts private and unknown values without mutating the source payload, preserving public checksum metadata.
Local-private export requires explicit intent; once granted it retains private values with a warning and never attempts cloud transmission.
Storage privacy metadata blocks or redacts unsafe export details (payload, secret material, cloud reference, direct SQL, storage bypass, concrete path) without leaking values.
Local-private intent metadata allows a private value with a warning_only decision (PRIVATE_LOCAL_ALLOWED_WITH_WARNING).
Protected-suspected or professional-claim boundary metadata blocks export with BLOCKING findings (PROTECTED_CONTENT_BLOCKED, PROFESSIONAL_BOUNDARY_BLOCKED).
Missing classification metadata does not silently export a value-bearing record; the value is redacted (MISSING_METADATA_REDACTED).
Redaction documentation and memory record scope boundaries (DEL-12-02, explicit metadata only, local-first, does not mutate source, invented fixtures only).
Changed files do not embed disallowed example content (standards names, allowable-stress tables, secrets, certification claims).
Checks for DEL-12-04 secret/private-library reference handling.
Private-library classification is deterministic and metadata-only (SPL-CLS- id, local_private_metadata_only posture, placeholder checksum, no payload, no secret material).
Public-report release keeps private reference metadata with warning only (PRIVATE_REFERENCE_METADATA_ONLY), preserving placeholder checksum.
Public fixture rejects private payloads, secret values, and unknown redistribution rights, requiring reference-only metadata and blocking unknown redistribution.
Public/shared/downstream release blocks storage boundary markers (payload, cloud/network, direct SQL, storage bypass, external secret manager) and emits no concrete paths.
Concrete private path helper withholds the path detail, emitting CONCRETE_PATH_REDUCED_TO_SAFE_METADATA.
Local-private intent is required for private references and payloads remain blocked even with intent (PRIVATE_PATH_PAYLOAD_REFERENCE_ONLY_REQUIRED).
Credential placeholder uses a fake key id and descriptor only, classified secret_like_data with no payload or secret material.
Secret/private-library documentation and memory record scope boundaries (DEL-12-04, metadata-only, local-first, invented fixtures only).
Changed files do not embed disallowed example content for the secret/private-library deliverable.
Policy checks for the telemetry-off-by-default contract (DEL-12-03 / PKG-12).
Initialization bans network transport, background upload jobs, upload queues, local telemetry persistence, endpoints, vendors, and external service clients.

Forbidden telemetry payload field classes include private models, code-specific rule data, private rule packs, libraries, reports, model hashes, file paths, secrets, protected standards, and professional/compliance claims.
Telemetry policy text is traceable to deliverable scope (DEL-12-03, PKG-12, SOW-037, OBJ-010).
Absent or malformed telemetry config fails closed to disabled.
Telemetry transport and persistence require explicit opt-in and a human-approved event allowlist; otherwise events are dropped locally without network behavior.
Event allowlist rejects unknown or unapproved fields.
Open telemetry decisions remain TBD without naming a vendor or endpoint, and no http/https or vendor names appear in policy.
resolve_telemetry_config disables telemetry for absent, empty, unknown, or malformed config, with no network transport or persistence initialized.
Enabled telemetry config requires opt-in, an approved consent surface, and an approved non-empty allowlist; missing any yields telemetry_gates_incomplete.
A prebuilt enabled TelemetryConfig is still re-checked and fails closed (telemetry_gates_incomplete) when gates are incomplete.
Allowlisted metadata event passes without payload construction or any network/endpoint/vendor/queue/persistence initialization.
Unknown event and unknown field are rejected before payload construction (telemetry_event_not_allowlisted, telemetry_field_not_allowlisted).
Forbidden field classes (private, protected, secret, path, model_hash, generated_report, professional_claim) are rejected as telemetry_forbidden_field before payload construction.
A payload-shaped event attempt is rejected before allowlist payload build (telemetry_payload_attempt_before_guard).
No runtime networking or product telemetry dependency was added (core/telemetry, apps/telemetry, schemas/telemetry.schema.yaml absent).
Focused tests for DEL-07-06 accessibility/usability baseline records.
Required accessibility finding fields are finding_id, category, outcome, source_surface, affected_control, severity, remediation_note, and evidence_refs.

Required accessibility finding categories include keyboard_path, focus_order, readable_label, warning_visibility, result_review_visibility, solve_state_feedback, contrast_readability, professional_boundary, and privacy_boundary.
Accessibility/usability baseline build is deterministic and order-independent over GUI contract records without mutating them.

Accessibility baseline (DEL-07-06) uses deterministic contract-record review with no live desktop runtime, accessibility_target_status TBD_by_human_project_authority, and makes no conformance or compliance claim.
Accessibility findings are canonically sorted, expose all required fields, cover required categories, and include pass/warning/fail/not_applicable outcomes.

Accessibility baseline surfaces unresolved-TBD diagnostic codes (PROPERTY_VALUE_UNRESOLVED, EDITOR_FIELD_VALUE_UNRESOLVED, RESULT_VALUE_OR_UNIT_UNRESOLVED, SOLVE_UX_TERMINAL_STATE_PENDING) and avoids forbidden compliance/certification text.
Stdlib checks for the adapter framework contract (DEL-10-02 / PKG-10).
Adapter framework keeps TBD decisions for external format list, transport protocol, endpoint syntax, execution model, plugin runtime, CI provider, release matrix, and local FEA package format.

Adapter no-bypass controls require using the public API boundary, unit validation, provenance/privacy preservation, persistence through application services, and forbid raw SQL, network access, filesystem-root choice, and code-compliance claims.
Adapter validation plan requires schema, unit, dimension, provenance, redistribution, privacy classification, and protected-content screening.
Adapter schema contract is strict and traceable to DEL-10-02, PKG-10, SOW-030, OBJ-009.
Adapter schema keeps runtime and format decisions TBD (interface_kind schema_first_format_neutral_adapter_framework; TbdDecisions all const TBD).
Adapter schema requires no-bypass controls (all const True), validation hooks (all required), human_review_required True, and adapter capabilities import/export/validate/contribution_review.
Adapter schema preserves diagnostics classes, privacy context (local_first True, telemetry_allowed False), result-envelope ref, and professional-boundary claims all False.
Invented adapter fixture is format-neutral and accepted (ACCEPTED_FORMAT_NEUTRAL_DECLARATION, format_status TBD, not parsed by framework, local_first True, telemetry_allowed False).
Concrete format selection is rejected (ADAPTER_FORMAT_SELECTED).
Direct persistence access (raw sqlite handle, table names, direct store mutation) is rejected (ADAPTER_FORBIDDEN_PERSISTENCE_ACCESS).
Missing provenance blocks the adapter declaration (ADAPTER_PROVENANCE_INCOMPLETE).
Protected-suspected redistribution quarantines the adapter declaration (ADAPTER_PROTECTED_CONTENT_SUSPECTED).
Disabling any no-bypass control rejects the declaration (ADAPTER_NO_BYPASS_CONTROL_DISABLED).
Operation-result builder preserves boundaries (not parsed by framework, local_first True, telemetry_allowed False, results schema ref, no compliance claim).
Adapter schema and fixture contain no forbidden status terms (CODE_COMPLIANT, CERTIFIED, SEALED, APPROVED_FOR_PROFESSIONAL_RELIANCE).
Premature resolution of a TBD decision is rejected (ADAPTER_DECISION_PREMATURE).
Focused tests for DEL-16-04 agent rationale boundary controls.

Agent rationale record is deterministic and preserves context (operation-set ref, source, actor, decision_support_only True, creates no accepted operation record, mutates no accepted model state, unresolved assumptions surfaced).
Agent rationale cannot mutate accepted state or bypass user acceptance (accepted state unchanged, software cannot accept engineering work or mutate accepted model state).

Missing context and unresolved assumptions are visible as TBD diagnostics (RATIONALE-AUDIT-CONTEXT-TBD, RATIONALE-VALIDATION-CONTEXT-TBD, RATIONALE-SOURCE-TBD, RATIONALE-ACTOR-TBD, RATIONALE-TEXT-TBD).

Prohibited professional-boundary claims (compliance, certification, sealing, authentication, professional approval, external validation, autonomous acceptance) are blocked, setting rationale status blocked_by_professional_boundary.
Prohibited claims appearing in copied operation/validation/audit context are blocked.
Enum-style prohibited claims in copied context (CODE_COMPLIANT, APPROVED, HUMAN_APPROVED_FOR_PROJECT) are blocked.
Lowercase 'approved' coordination context is not treated as professional approval; rationale is captured_for_user_review.
Rationale output boundary makes no prohibited claims in serialized output and asserts software_makes_approval_claim is False.
Stdlib checks for the code-neutral analysis boundary schema.
Analysis boundary forbids automatic compliance/certification/sealing/approval statuses in automatic status vocabularies.
Rule-pack reference fields required: rule_pack_id, version, checksum, source_notice, supplied_by_user, redistribution_status, provenance.

Analysis-boundary schema fixes authority model: mechanics_authority solver_result_only, rule_check_authority software_computation_using_user_data, human_acceptance_authority external_hash_bound_human_record_only.
Mechanics solve statuses are MODEL_INCOMPLETE and MECHANICS_SOLVED; rule-check statuses are RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE, USER_RULE_CHECKED, USER_RULE_FAILED, disjoint from forbidden automatic statuses.
Professional-boundary claim fields are const False and human_review_required is const True in the analysis-boundary schema.
HumanAcceptanceRef carries human_status HUMAN_APPROVED_FOR_PROJECT bound to evidence hashes, kept as a required external human-acceptance reference.
Analysis-boundary fixtures preserve the code-neutral authority split across RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE, USER_RULE_CHECKED, and USER_RULE_FAILED states.
Human acceptance ref in fixtures is scoped as external_human_record_not_software_status and automatic status scope excludes forbidden statuses.
Focused tests for DEL-14-04 analysis-run comparison.
Analysis-run comparison is deterministic and preserves run context (comparison id, left/right run ids, model-state refs, hashes, solver version).
Comparison computes unit-normalized deltas and tolerance classification while keeping raw evidence separate (raw_delta vs normalized_delta, exceeds_tolerance_profile classification).
Incompatible or missing unit metadata produces diagnostics, not deltas (ARC-DIMENSION-INCOMPATIBLE, ARC-UNIT-CONVERSION-UNSUPPORTED).
Missing mapping and missing result data are explicit blocking findings (ARC-MAPPING-NOT-COMPARABLE, ARC-RESULT-DATA-MISSING).
Carried run diagnostics are preserved as review evidence (ARC-RUN-DIAGNOSTIC-LEFT, ARC-RUN-DIAGNOSTIC-RIGHT) with severities and affected refs.
Comparison output emits no prohibited professional claims; professional boundary has human_review_required True and all claim flags False.
Focused tests for DEL-14-02 analysis-run record generation.
Preview result builds a deterministic immutable run record (DEL-14-02) with read-only immutability policy and statuses HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED, MECHANICS_SOLVED, RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE.
Generated analysis-run envelope validates against the analysis_run schema.

Generated run binds run basis refs (model state, settings, unit system, load basis, solver version, build), diagnostics, result refs with hashes, and a professional boundary with all claim flags False.
Run contract status uses the SCA-003 local SQLite project store: sql_public_contract False, direct_sql_access_allowed False, hosted_db_allowed False, network_required False, sidecars rebuildable.
Analysis-run schema binds the physical container to the SCA-003 profile (sqlite_local_project_store, canonical_json_jcs_payload truth).
Result refs bind computed result ids to hashes with result_family, invented_public_example privacy classification, and result_value payload scope.
Mutating a result value changes the corresponding result hash.
Persistence history preserves the analysis-run basis after an unrelated model change, with stable run-history hash manifest across round-trip.

Validation blocks a run missing the human-review boundary or result hashes and asserting a compliance claim (ANALYSIS_RUN_HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED_MISSING, ANALYSIS_RUN_PROFESSIONAL_BOUNDARY_VIOLATION, ANALYSIS_RUN_RESULT_HASH_MISSING).
Stdlib checks for the analysis run schema (DEL-14-02 / PKG-14 / SOW-072 / OBJ-016).
Forbidden analysis-run statuses include HUMAN_APPROVED_FOR_PROJECT, CODE_COMPLIANT, CERTIFIED, SEALED, APPROVED.
Analysis-run schema is strict (additionalProperties False, no defaults), requires root contract fields, and binds run contract status to model_state and results schemas.

PhysicalProjectContainer is bound to SCA-003 sqlite_local_project_store with sql_public_contract False, direct_sql_access_allowed False, hosted_db_allowed False, network_required False, sidecars rebuildable.

AnalysisRunRecord requires run identity, basis refs, diagnostics, result refs, hashes, analysis status, reproducibility, immutability policy, professional boundary, and provenance; run_kind enum includes mechanics_solve and rule_check.

AnalysisStatus enum includes MODEL_INCOMPLETE, MECHANICS_SOLVED, RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE, USER_RULE_CHECKED, USER_RULE_FAILED, HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED and is disjoint from forbidden statuses; records must contain HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
Checksum requires algorithm, canonicalization (JCS/NONE/TBD), payload_ref, payload_scope (including analysis_run_record, result_envelope, result_value), and value.
Immutability policy: run record is read-only, changes create a new analysis run, and a hash change invalidates external acceptance.
ResultRef requires result_ref, result_family, hash_refs, privacy_classification, provenance; RulePackRef requires private_payload_redacted const True.
Professional boundary in analysis-run schema asserts human_review_required True and all software-claim flags False, with no forbidden compliance/certification text anywhere in schema strings.
Stdlib checks for the analysis status schema.

Required analysis-status vocabulary: MODEL_INCOMPLETE, MECHANICS_SOLVED, RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE, USER_RULE_CHECKED, USER_RULE_FAILED, HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED, HUMAN_APPROVED_FOR_PROJECT (the last being human-only, not automatic).
Forbidden automatic statuses include USER_RULE_PASSED, CODE_COMPLIANT, CERTIFIED, SEALED, APPROVED, HUMAN_APPROVED_FOR_PROJECT, PROFESSIONAL_ACCEPTANCE.
Analysis-status schema requires USER_RULE_CHECKED to carry at least one rule_check_details entry and keeps USER_RULE_PASSED out of vocabularies and outcomes.
UserRuleCheckDetails requires rule_pack_ref, evaluation_outcome, checked_at, evidence_refs; outcome allows checked_no_failures_reported but not USER_RULE_PASSED or accepted_for_project.
HumanAcceptanceRecord requires acceptance_outcome and bound_hashes, fixes acceptance_status const HUMAN_APPROVED_FOR_PROJECT, requires a human actor, and carries no software_status.
Downstream automatic-status surfaces (analysis_boundary, results, api result_envelope) exclude human-approval and USER_RULE_PASSED claims.
Focused tests for the internal analytical solver-boundary adapter.

Adapter emits deterministic solver-boundary DTOs: model refs, node indices/coordinates with units, straight-pipe connectivity with governed y-reference, property bindings, support targets, load case records, and per-load DTO records with source chains and JCS payload hashes.
Adapter does not infer missing solver property bindings; a missing shear modulus yields no property bindings and ASBA-MATERIAL-PROPERTY-MISSING.
Adapter diagnoses non-canonical load semantics without mapping them (ASBA-LOAD-NONCANONICAL-SEMANTICS-UNSUPPORTED), blocking solver application.
Adapter blocks invalid straight-pipe y-reference orientation: parallel, zero, and non-finite references each emit a distinct ASBA diagnostic and produce no connectivity.
Adapter blocks an unordered uniform-load span at runtime (ASBA-LOAD-SPAN-FRACTION-ORDER), blocking solver application.
Adapter preserves load-record failures as result-boundary diagnostics (unsupported record/type, unresolved target, unsupported dimension, non-finite quantity) without inventing user_loads.
Adapter requires the analytical_solver_model role; a physical_source_of_truth role yields empty outputs and ASBA-SOURCE-ROLE-UNEXPECTED.
